source_note: Includes uncommitted layout, regression and packaging changes from this rebuild.

coverage: study/model navigation, inline checkpoint save, run and result focus without leaving the model
same-turn duplicate submission and delayed submission across panel remounts
failed submission retry and cancellation while a run is observing its job
compact and RTL research controls in zh, de, ar and es
fullscreen and window-local modeling, save recovery, batch editing and dock resize
browser_regressions.backend: isolated synthetic API; not numerical qualification

installed_acceptance.model_preparation: real Pyodide/PWDT helper generated four truss bays, span 12 m, height 2 m, load_y -800 N
operations: create dedicated acceptance project through PWDT
save a model checkpoint through the nearby Save form
submit once through the nearby Run button
observe completed job from installed Rust Agent through installed Orchestra
open result inspector with nearby Result button; model viewport remains fully visible
installed_acceptance.cleanup: temporary project, model, checkpoint, job and result removed; original script template restored
installed_acceptance.final_payload_note: The installed interactive journey preceded the final panel-remount lock hardening. The final production payload includes that hardening and passed all 18 browser regressions.

limitations: This report qualifies a bounded UI journey, not all GUI operations or numerical solver accuracy.
Only macOS installed execution was checked; Linux and Windows native acceptance remains separate.
No public distribution, notarization or SDK registry publication was performed.
